system.description:
When on the march, Dwarven armies use a complex system of horn signals to transmit information between camps. The system is called “links” because it connects the Dwarven regiments like links of sausage. The Links skill gives the character the ability to perform and decode the signals.

Obstacles: Start and stop signals, Ob 1. Danger signals, Ob 2. Marching orders, Ob 3. Battle commands, Ob 4. Other complex communications, Ob 5.

FoRKs: Stentorious Singing

Skill Type: Academic. Tools: Yes, a big brass horn.’

Restrictions: Dwarves only in character burning

Root: Will/For

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 280
